input.question: In the players, how many were out by hit wicket?
input.evidence: out by hit wicket refers to Out_Name = 'hit wicket'
input.proposal_sql:
SELECT COUNT(P.Player_Name) 
FROM Wicket_Taken AS T1 
INNER JOIN Out_Type AS T2 ON T1.Kind_Out = T2.Out_Id 
INNER JOIN Player AS P ON T1.Player_Out = P.Player_Id 
WHERE T2.Out_Name = 'hit wicket'
input.reference_sql: SELECT Player_Out FROM Wicket_Taken AS T1 INNER JOIN Out_Type AS T2 ON T1.Kind_Out = T2.Out_Id WHERE Out_Name = 'hit wicket'

input.question: What is the ratio of professors and students?
input.evidence: professors refers to professor = 1; students refers to student = 1; ratio = divide(count(person.p_id) when professor = 1, count(person.p_id) when student = 1)
input.proposal_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN professor = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN student = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM person
input.reference_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE  WHEN professor = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE  WHEN student = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS per FROM person

input.question: Provide the name, capital city and its official language of the country with the highest life expectancy.
input.evidence: capital city refers to Capital; official language refers to IsOfficial = 'T'; highest life expectancy refers to MAX(LifeExpectancy);
input.proposal_sql:
SELECT c.Name, ci.Name, cl.Language
FROM Country AS c
JOIN City AS ci ON c.Capital = ci.ID
JOIN CountryLanguage AS cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T'
ORDER BY c.LifeExpectancy DESC
LIMIT 1
input.reference_sql: SELECT T1.Name, T1.Capital, T2.Language FROM Country AS T1 INNER JOIN CountryLanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode INNER JOIN City AS T3 ON T1.Code = T3.CountryCode WHERE T2.IsOfficial = 'T' ORDER BY T1.LifeExpectancy DESC LIMIT 1

input.question: Who is the youngest player who is still living. State the given name and date of birth.

FROM Master
